hardware: Intel Core i9-14900KF host; WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04; 16 logical CPUs; 24 GiB RAM
method: Fresh output directories, identical configs and compilers, no compiler cache, warm filesystem cache, sequential runs. Initial paired runs alternate make/ninja then ninja/make. Final Ninja candidate rechecks run after the retained GNU Make baselines; both have two samples per job count. Configuration, generation and verification are excluded.
caveats: Selected versions/configurations, not a reproduction of the original Gentoo/Ryzen environment.
Two measured runs per tool/job-count; no confidence interval or sub-percent significance claim.
Ninja only schedules the outer Kbuild graph; recursive child parsing occurs during timed execution.
Openmktr is statically linked with musl/libc++ from the pinned Chimera image, using Clang 22.1.8 and O2/ThinLTO; third-party builds use host Clang 18.1.3.
peak_rss_kib is the largest process, not aggregate process-tree memory.
Kernel image format and artifact equality were checked; no kernel boot was performed.
Exec tracing is a separate diagnostic run; its timings are not used in the comparison.
Bare direct execution without a shared FIFO retains recursive serialization.
